title: Breaking the Prophecy
next_chapter_hook: Just as his fingertips touched the Turtle Shell, a warm current surged into his palm from his father's presence—a guardian spanning eighteen years, now waiting to be awakened.

text.content: The moment the fusion completed, Chen Ji felt his consciousness torn open. In the chaotic darkness, a blurry scene exploded like thunder—a woman's back, imprisoned in endless darkness. Her hair tangled like withered grass, clothes in tatters, yet still stubbornly straightening her spine. It was his missing sister, Chen Nian. Chen Ji's heart clenched, his knuckles white from strain. Though blurry, he instantly recognized the backdrop—Tianqing Sect's Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds. Had Nian-er been trapped there all along?

At this moment, the first page's seal of the Tianji Record shattered completely. An elderly, gentle voice rang out in Chen Ji's Mental Sea: "Awakened? The residual soul memory fusion should have taken three more days, but you were faster than I anticipated." Mo Xiansheng's residual soul materialized like a wisp of blue smoke, his withered face showing a hint of relief. "It seems the girl's fate is indeed closely intertwined with yours."

dialogue.content: "Since you've witnessed this, it's time to reveal some truths to you." Mo Xiansheng's voice dropped low. "Do you know the true weakness of the Eye of Heavenly Dao?"

text.content: Chen Ji's heart surged. "Please, Master, explain!" He suppressed his excitement, voice trembling slightly. Mo Xiansheng, the chess guardian left by Chen Xuan who knew all the secrets of the Tianji Record, was finally willing to reveal them. Mo Xiansheng slowly raised his hand, and a blurry star chart appeared in the void: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao is not invincible. Its greatest weakness is its inability to perceive what it has actively abandoned—and the prophetic seers throughout history are precisely the discarded pieces it has abandoned."

Chen Ji's eyes flashed with insight, instantly grasping the deeper meaning. The Eye of Heavenly Dao treats prophetic seers as chess pieces, discarding them when they lose their usefulness. It is precisely in these "abandoned" gaps that the possibility of counterattack lies hidden. "The Tianji Record Fragment is merely a fragment; the true complete version lies deep within the secret realm," Mo Xiansheng's voice grew grave. "To obtain the complete version requires two keys."

"Two keys?" Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly. Mo Xiansheng nodded, his withered fingers tracing two light patterns in the void: "The first key lies within your bloodline. The Tianji Record's master recognition requires dual authentication—your Chen family blood is the first layer. And the second layer..." he paused, "requires cooperation from another person whose fate is connected to yours."

Chen Ji's heart lurched. A person whose fate was linked to his? Could it be—"Nian-er?" He remembered the woman's back in the blurry vision, his voice tightening. Mo Xiansheng nodded: "Exactly. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key itself is part of the second key. I had thought it impossible to retrieve your sister after the Holy Sect took her all those years ago... but just now, during your residual soul fusion, I sensed her presence."

"She's still alive!" Chen Ji's hands trembled slightly—the overwhelming hope and worry suppressed for so long finally broke through its dam. He recalled the moment the Holy Sect took Chen Nian away, when he was just a helpless teenager, watching his sister being dragged into the abyss. Over the years, he searched secretly without pause, never receiving any definite news. Mo Xiansheng's appearance finally revealed a glimmer of hope.

dialogue.content: "Alive, but her situation is dire." Mo Xiansheng sighed. "The Holy Sect has cultivated her as a vessel for so many years; her bloodline power has been mostly depleted. If we cannot find the complete Tianji Record soon, her lifespan... no more than three years."

text.content: "Three years..." Chen Ji murmured, his voice terrifyingly calm. Yet Mo Xiansheng saw a tempest in his eyes—an impending flood of fury and determination. The boy who had always posed as a废物 was now radiating a dangerous aura. "Master, if the second key requires her cooperation, I'll go to the Holy Sect right now to rescue her!"

"Impossible!" Mo Xiansheng decisively rejected. "Do you think the Holy Sect cultivated her for so long for nothing? Because she's the perfect Heavenly Fate Lock Key—as long as she's present when you use the Tianji Record, she can share the consumption! The Holy Sect spared her life specifically to lure you!" Chen Ji suddenly snapped awake—he had nearly fallen into the Holy Sect's trap. Acting rashly would not only fail to save his sister but also drag himself into destruction.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He was never impulsive; his earlier loss of composure served as a warning—his sister was his weakness, and this could never be exploited by enemies. "Then what should I do? Please guide me, Master." Mo Xiansheng smiled faintly, admiration flickering in his eyes: "You're quite composed. This is the answer Chen Xuan would appreciate."

choice.prompt: As Mo Xiansheng was about to continue, Chen Ji suddenly remembered something. "Do you recall the keepsake our father left before disappearing? That Turtle Shell..."

choices.description: Taking Out the Turtle Shell, Asking Mo Xiansheng to Examine Its Connection to the Keys

text.content: Chen Ji took out the worn Turtle Shell from his chest. Mo Xiansheng's residual soul shuddered: "This is... Chen Xuan's keepsake? You've been carrying it all this time?" His voice was unusually emotional. "This Turtle Shell isn't an ordinary keepsake—it's the container for the second key Chen Xuan left behind!"

Chen Ji was overjoyed. His father's keepsake was actually the key? He carefully examined the Turtle Shell, covered in dense ancient runes, some he could even decipher—these were inheritance marks of the Chen family bloodline. Father had long foreseen he would walk this path, so he left guidance in advance.

choices.description: Containing His Excitement, Continuing to Listen to Mo Xiansheng's Full Plan
choices.visible_reward: Act only after obtaining complete information
choices.risk_hint: May have overlooked some key details

text.content: Mo Xiansheng continued: "Both keys need to be activated simultaneously to unlock the complete Tianji Record. You already have the first one, the second..." He gave Chen Ji a meaningful look. "The thing your father left you, you should still have it, right?"

Chen Ji froze. The thing his father left him? Other than this Turtle Shell, he couldn't think of anything else. His hand unconsciously moved to his chest, fingers brushing against the smooth edge of the Turtle Shell, and a familiar aura rushed into his heart. So his father had long paved the way for him, only waiting for him to discover it.

No matter which path he chose, the answer pointed to the same place—the secrets of the Tianji Record hidden within the Turtle Shell. Chen Ji pressed the Turtle Shell to his forehead, and a warm current flowed into him from his palm—that was his father's aura! Eighteen years had passed, this familiar sensation nearly moved him to tears. The runes on the Turtle Shell began to glow, resonating with the power in his bloodline.

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, tinged with emotion: "Chen Xuan knew his days were numbered back then, so he sealed information about the second key into the Turtle Shell in advance. He wagered that you would survive to this day, and even more, that you would choose the right path. It seems he won his bet." Chen Ji gripped the Turtle Shell tightly, complex emotions surging in his heart—his father's foresight and sacrifice ran far deeper than he had imagined.

choice.prompt: The information within the Turtle Shell gradually became clear, and Chen Ji needed to decide his next move. Mo Xiansheng hinted that the complete Tianji Record was hidden in the deepest part of the secret realm, but there were powerful restrictions there.

choices.description: Strike while the iron is hot, attempt to enter the deepest part of the secret realm now
choices.risk_hint: The restriction's power is unknown, the consumption may be enormous

text.content: "Time waits for no one!" A resolute light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He bid farewell to Mo Xiansheng and vanished on the spot in a flash. Mo Xiansheng gazed at his departing direction and murmured, "That impatient trait is exactly like Chen Xuan's. Very well, some roads must be walked oneself before knowing their depth."

choices.description: This fusion consumed quite a bit, recover one's condition first before acting
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may get there first

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself to calm down. He knew that acting rashly in his current state would likely do more harm than good. Moreover, news of his sister had already thrown his heart into turmoil—making decisions now would be too unwise. He sat cross-legged and began to regulate his breathing. The Turtle Shell lay quietly in his palm, its warm aura continuously nourishing his meridians.

Just then, the runes on the Turtle Shell suddenly illuminated, and information flooded directly into Chen Ji's mind—it was his father's final divine message: "Ji'er, if you can see these words, it means your father is no longer among the living. But you need not grieve, Father foresaw this day long ago. The complete Tianji Record lies at the heart of the secret realm, and the method to unlock it rests within this Turtle Shell. Remember, bloodline as the guide, Nian'er as the key—the Eye of Heavenly Dao... can be broken!"

Tears welled in Chen Ji's tiger-like eyes, but he forced them back. His father's testament crossed through time and space to guide him—he couldn't let this painstaking effort go to waste. He carefully studied the runes on the Turtle Shell and discovered that what was recorded there was precisely the cultivation method for the core section of the Tianji Record—so his father had long integrated part of the inheritance into the Turtle Shell. "Chen Xuan ah Chen Xuan, just how many backup plans did you hide?" Chen Ji murmured to himself, yet his lips couldn't help but curve upward.

Just then, a thunderous roar echoed from the distance. The entire secret realm trembled, as if some colossal being was awakening. Chen Ji rose abruptly, gazing toward where the sound originated—that was the direction of the secret realm's deepest point, the direction where the complete Tianji Record lay. "Someone has gotten there first." A cold light flickered in his eyes, the sharp edge suppressed beneath his 'trash' persona finally beginning to leak out.

In any case, he now knew the key to breaking the局—the complete Tianji Record, activated with both keys, would allow him to counter the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Nian'er was the second key; he had to find her as soon as possible. But now that someone had invaded the secret realm's depths, Chen Ji had to make a choice: seize back what belonged to him first, or wait and observe for the right moment?\n\nRegardless, the Turtle Shell left by his father was radiating a warm glow, as if saying: "I have waited for you for many years. Now, it is time."
